newsitem.title: CANADA: CanOxy acquires Colombia exploration blocks.
newsitem.headline: CanOxy acquires Colombia exploration blocks.

text.p: Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd said on Friday it entered into contracts with Colombia state oil company Ecopetrol to explore two blocks in Colombia's Putumayo Basin.
Under the terms of the contracts, CanOxy will reprocess seismic data and acquire 200 km of new seismic for the Paramo Este and Paramo Oeste blocks over a two-year period, the company said.
It has an option of entering into an exploration drilling phase in the third year for the lands.
CanOxy holds a 100 percent working interest in the blocks that comprise 575,000 acres.

The Paramo blocks are adjacent to the Troyano Block, in which the company recently bought a 50 percent stake. It said the acreage provided it with several low- to moderate-risk exploration opportunities within a proven basin.
"We now have a dominant exploration position in this attractive and underexplored basin," CanOxy chief executive David Hentschel said in a statement.
